title: Verify "Skip to content" link is visually hidden by default
preconditions: Terms & Conditions page (https://dev.skyline.glass/terms-conditions/) is loaded, no keyboard interaction yet
steps: Without interacting via keyboard, inspect the top of the page for a visible "Skip to content" link
expected_result: The "Skip to content" link is not visibly rendered on the page before any keyboard interaction (e.g. positioned off-screen or visually hidden).

title: Verify "Skip to content" link becomes visible on keyboard focus
steps: Press Tab once to move keyboard focus to the first focusable element
expected_result: The "Skip to content" link becomes visible on-screen with a clear focus indicator as soon as it receives keyboard focus.

title: Verify activating "Skip to content" link moves focus to the main content area
preconditions: Terms & Conditions page is loaded, "Skip to content" link is focused
steps: Press Tab to focus the "Skip to content" link
expected_result: Keyboard focus and page scroll position move to the main content area (past the header/nav), and the link itself returns to its hidden state.
